data.name: Aazaad
data.long_meaning: The name Aazaad is derived from the Arabic root ‘A-Z-D’, which means 'to free, deliver, or liberate'. In Islamic context, the name signifies the one who is mighty and powerful, as well as one who is free from sin and its consequences. The name is associated with the idea of being free from worldly desires and attaining spiritual liberation. It is a name of great significance in Islamic and spiritual traditions, as it represents the ultimate goal of human life - to seek Allah's pleasure and attain eternal freedom and peace.
